chunks: And he said regarding ten people who jointly participated in killing a man: “The family of the slain may choose whichever of them they wish and kill him, and his heirs may then return against the rest for nine-tenths of the blood money.”

key_terms.أَهْلُ ٱلْمَقْتُولِ: the family or heirs of the person who was killed
key_terms.أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ: the legal heirs of the executed killer who may claim compensation
key_terms.بِتِسْعَةِ أَعْشَارِ ٱلدِّيَةِ: nine-tenths of the blood money owed in compensation
key_terms.ٱشْتَرَكُوا فِي قَتْلِ رَجُلٍ: collective participation in the killing of one man
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةِ: financial compensation for unlawful killing or bodily injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if ten people jointly kill one man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling for a case in which ten people jointly kill one man. The heirs of the victim may exact qisas from one of the killers, and the heirs of the executed killer are then entitled to recover from the remaining participants nine-tenths of the diyah.
